cultural_notes: Roswell is a center for acequia-like irrigated farming, dairying, and ranching on the Pecos Valley plain -- a working agricultural and petroleum economy, not a tourist town (source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roswell,_New_Mexico)

Carlsbad Caverns, in the Guadalupe Mountains (a segment of the greater Sacramento range) on the Chihuahuan desert, is a UNESCO World Heritage site laid down in a 265-million-year-old fossil reef (source: nps.gov Carlsbad Caverns; britannica.com; kids.britannica.com)

an Apache story tells of a medicine man who ventured into the caverns and was never seen again, with annual tribal visits leaving food at the entrance -- a cited Indigenous cultural association; keep any reference respectful and consent-aware (source: newmexicomagazine.org history of Carlsbad Caverns)
